query:
WITH claimed AS (
            SELECT id FROM gpu_jobs
            WHERE id = $1 AND state = 'queued'
            FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
        )
        UPDATE gpu_jobs SET
            state = 'running',
            started_at = NOW(),
            queued_ms = $2,
            blocked_history =
                gpu_jobs_close_episode(blocked_history, blocked_reason, blocked_since),
            blocked_reason = NULL,
            blocked_since = NULL,
            alerted_at = NULL
        WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM claimed)
